attempts.prompt:
An event journal sometimes reports the wrong number of reversals and the wrong longest interval. Legal order is increasing minute, then decreasing priority, then increasing serial. Identical events may repeat. Count adjacent reversals and the largest number of consecutive events in legal order anywhere in the batch. A reversal starts the next interval at the incoming event. Empty journals return zeros and batches are independent.

Find and repair the regression. You may inspect any current project source and run ./verify. Stay in the current project, preserve the public interface, and change only production code. The runner applies the submitted edits together and runs ./verify. The verifier and source collection already ran. Use the prepared context directly if sufficient.
The reachable sources are included. Function bodies show the compiler's grouping. Return each changed function's name and complete single-line TIDE body. Signatures: (if test yes no), (fold items seed accumulator row item step). Each argument is one expression.

{"passed":18,"failed":24,"first_failure":{"input":[{"minute":1,"priority":0,"serial":0},{"minute":1,"priority":0,"serial":0}],"expected":{"breaks":0,"longest":2},"actual":{"breaks":1,"longest":1}}}

--- event.tide ---
record Event
minute:i priority:i serial:i


--- sequence.tide ---
earlier incoming:{Event} prior:{Event} > b
(or (< (get minute incoming) (get minute prior)) (and (eq (get minute incoming) (get minute prior)) (or (> (get priority incoming) (get priority prior)) (and (eq (get priority incoming) (get priority prior)) (not (> (get serial incoming) (get serial prior)))))))


--- streak.tide ---
record Progress
prior:?{Event} breaks:i current:i longest:i

advance state_value:{Progress} incoming:{Event} > {Progress}
(let backward (case (get prior state_value) false previous (earlier incoming previous)) (let count (if backward 1 (+ (get current state_value) 1)) (let peak (get longest state_value) (make Progress prior (some incoming) breaks (+ (get breaks state_value) (if backward 1 0)) current count longest (if (> count peak) count peak)))))


--- summary.tide ---
record Report
breaks:i longest:i

journal events:*{Event} > {Report}
(let empty (make Progress prior (nil {Event}) breaks 0 current 0 longest 0) (let state_value (fold events empty totals row item (advance totals item)) (make Report breaks (get breaks state_value) longest (get current state_value))))

main batches:**{Event} > *{Report}
(fold batches (list {Report} 0) reports row batch (append reports (journal batch)))
